blocks.text: Niño Muhlach’s wife, Diane Abby Tupaz, defended the actor after he was called out over his alleged lack of assistance towards a motorcycle rider who incurred damages after the actor’s vehicle figured in a road crash in Antipolo City last month. Nicolas Villanueva posted on Facebook on Sunday, Sept. 13, claiming that Muhlach has yet to replace his damaged motorcycle three weeks after the road accident. “Sir NIÑO MUHLACH pangatlong linggo na po. Parang binabalewala na po ninyo yung nangyari sakin. Ang galing galing niyong mangako pag may camera. Wala pala kayung isang salita sa mga sinasabi niyo. Di pa ako […]...
